display.purpose: The rank readout (#3 of 144) in the rank head; the only size above 14px.

title.purpose: Uppercase section headings, day heads and offering group labels in secondary text.

body.purpose: Default for codes, times, values and labels; tabular numerals and slashed zero on.

body-prose.purpose: Course titles, helper paragraphs, banners, empty state, results footnote.

label.purpose: 10px uppercase tracked keys: readout keys, results column heads, the REGISTER label.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the build: the :focus-within halo on a text field. Not elevation.

shadows.name: moved-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset ring on a result row that just moved after a re-rank; animates to transparent over 1400ms.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition and the moved-row animation.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Colour state changes: background, border-color, color, opacity, switch knob.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Position changes: criterion row transform, course block transform and opacity.

motion.name: moved
motion.purpose: Inset ring fade on a re-ranked result row.

motion.name: copied
motion.purpose: How long the Copy button stays in its primary 'Copied' state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transition and animation durations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: results panel drops below the grid as a 320px row; left panel narrows to 300px.

breakpoints.name: one-column

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; width: 292px; background: var(--bg-0, #0b0d11); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #262d3d); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-1, #e7eaf1); font: 400 12.5px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #6e9cf5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgb(110 156 245 / 0.14)); } .ds-field.ds-invalid { border-color: var(--danger, #f0716f); } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3, #7f8aa3); } .ds-field-hint { color: var(--text-3, #7f8aa3); font-size: 11px; }

components.css: .ds-results { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 328px; padding: 4px 6px; background: var(--bg-1, #10131a); font: 400 12.5px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1; } .ds-result { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 6px 0 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: none; border: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--text-2, #a0a8b8); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-result:hover { background: var(--bg-2, #161a22); } .ds-result.ds-selected { background: var(--accent-soft, rgb(110 156 245 / 0.14)); color: var(--text-1, #e7eaf1); } .ds-result:focus { outline: none; } .ds-result:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ring, rgb(110 156 245 / 0.55)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-r { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3, #7f8aa3); text-align: right; padding-right: 2px; } .ds-result.ds-selected .ds-r { color: var(--accent, #6e9cf5); } .ds-v { text-align: right; font-size: 12px; } .ds-v.ds-lead { color: var(--text-1, #e7eaf1); font-weight: 500; } .ds-sub { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-3, #7f8aa3); margin-left: 4px; } .ds-codes { grid-column: 2 / -1; display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3, #7f8aa3); margin-top: -2px; } .ds-codes span { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sw { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 2px; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: 1px; } .ds-result.ds-moved { animation: ds-moved 1400ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-moved { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-ring, rgb(110 156 245 / 0.55)); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px transparent; } }

narrative.overview:
A single-user tool a CMU student opens at night, at registration time, to find the exact lecture and section codes to enter. The world is the category standard for a scheduler (inputs left, Monday-to-Friday grid centre, ranked list right) executed at Linear's craft level: a dark-only interface built from four steps of cool near-black, 1px hairlines, one desaturated electric blue, and a monospace voice. Nothing is decorative; monospace is the product's own language (course codes, section labels, clock times, ranks, tabular numerals), so JetBrains Mono carries everything that is data and Inter is reserved for the few sentences of prose and course titles.

Density is high and even. The body size is 12.5px, controls are 28px tall, list rows are 26–44px, and section padding is 14px. Depth is tonal, never cast: surfaces step up by lightness and hairlines separate regions; there are no box-shadows anywhere in the build except the 3px soft halo on a focused text field. Colour is held in reserve: the blue appears only on the selected result, the leading criterion, the primary action, the focus ring, and the "on" state of icon controls. Course identity is carried by eight muted hues at 16% alpha fills with full-strength text.

Motion is short and eased out hard (120ms / 200ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), used for state changes only. The one deliberate moment is the results list re-sorting in place when the ranking order changes: moved rows carry a 1px inset blue ring that fades over 1.4s.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (color-scheme: dark, no light theme); four cool near-black surfaces plus two hairline tones.
Monospace-first typography with tabular numerals and slashed zero on by default; Inter only for prose and course titles.
One accent (signal blue) for selection, lead, primary action and focus; semantic red / amber / green only as 14% tints with full-strength text.
Flat, hairline-bordered surfaces; no gradients, no shadows, no blur.
Eight course hues as hsl() triplets, applied as 16% fill / 45% border / 100% text.
Short eased-out transitions; motion only as a response to state.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal blue marks exactly four things: what is selected, what leads, the primary action, and focus. It is never used for decoration, headings, or icons at rest.

rules.name: The Tint-Plus-Ink Rule
rules.body: Status and course colours never fill a surface at full strength. The fill is the colour at 14–16% alpha; the text is the colour at 100%. The only solid colour fill in the world is the primary button.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by 1px hairline borders, never by shadow, gradient, or a change of more than one surface step.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: If it is a code, a time, a number or a rank it is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. If it is a sentence it is Inter. No exceptions.

rules.name: The Twelve-and-a-Half Rule
rules.body: Body is 12.5px. Everything else is within 10–15px; nothing is larger than the rank display at 15px.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts. Hover lifts a surface by one tonal step; focus draws a ring; selection tints. If a future popover needs separation it must earn it with a hairline and a surface step first.

dos: Do keep controls at 28px (24px small) with a 6px radius and a 1px hairline-strong border; hover is one tonal step up, not a transform.
Do set every code, time, rank and number in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals; reserve Inter for sentences and course titles.
Do reserve signal blue for selection, lead, primary action and focus; the lead criterion and selected result are the only blue-filled rows on screen.
Do build status and course colour as a 14–16% tint fill with the full-strength colour as text and (for course blocks) a 45% border.
Do separate regions with 1px hairline borders and surface steps; wells sit one step below their panel on ink-floor.
Do use the standard ease cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) at 120ms for colour state and 200ms for position; honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do draw icons as 16-unit line paths at 1.5 stroke with round caps, rendered at 12–14px.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients, blur or glows; the only halo in the world is the 3px focus halo on a field.
Don't introduce a light theme or theme switch; the world is color-scheme: dark only.
Don't fill a surface with a status or course colour at full strength; solid fills belong to the primary button alone.
Don't use a second accent or a hue-coded heading; headings are 11px uppercase mono in secondary text.
Don't set text above 15px or below 9px; the type world lives between 10px labels and the 15px rank display.
Don't replace drawn line icons with glyph fonts, emoji or an icon package.
